statement.zh:
**算法**：Falcon 格签名（Falcon）。### GPV 哈希—签名

Falcon 是 GPV 框架的 NTRU 格签名：把消息哈希到目标点，用陷门短基采样一个靠近目标的短格向量，输出该向量；验证检查它确实短且落在正确陪集。### NTRU 格与快速傅里叶采样

私钥是 NTRU 方程 fG−gF=q 的解 (f,g,F,G)，构成 NTRU 格的短基；签名在 FFT 域递归分裂，用离散高斯 SamplerZ 在叶节点采样，成本 O(n log n)。安全性归约到 NTRU 格上的 SIS。### 参数

Falcon-512 的公钥 897 B、签名约 666 B；Falcon-1024 的公钥 1793 B、签名约 1280 B。签名是变长编码，验证必须按参数集的上限检查长度。
statement.en:
**Algorithm**: Falcon (Falcon 格签名).### GPV hash-and-sign

Falcon is a GPV-style NTRU lattice signature: it hashes the message to a target point, uses a trapdoor short basis to sample a short lattice vector near that target, and outputs the vector; verification checks that it is short and lies in the correct coset.

statement.zh: Falcon 的定位是“最小的公钥加签名足迹”：在 NIST 三类格签名中，它的联合尺寸最小、验证最快，适合带宽和存储受限的 TLS 证书、JOSE/COSE 令牌和嵌入式固件签名。它不需要 AES 或大矩阵，验签只做多项式乘法和哈希；签名端的快速傅里叶采样让它在通用 CPU 上达到数千次每秒，验签再快五到十倍。
statement.en: Falcon targets the smallest public-key-plus-signature footprint: among the NIST lattice signatures it has the smallest combined size and the fastest verification, which suits bandwidth- and storage-constrained TLS certificates, JOSE/COSE tokens and embedded firmware signatures.It needs no AES or large matrices; verification is polynomial multiplication plus hashing.

statement.zh: 用于 TLS 1.3 的 FN-DSA 草案、JOSE/COSE 的 FN-DSA-512/1024、代码签名和固件签名；NIST 正把它标准化为 FIPS 206。工程要点：签名需要新鲜随机 salt；Gaussian sampler 必须常量时间；浮点 FFT 在不同平台要防 NaN、异常值和侧信道；不要把内部随机数跨签名复用。
statement.en: It is used in TLS 1.3 FN-DSA drafts, JOSE/COSE FN-DSA-512/1024, code signing and firmware signing; NIST is standardizing it as FIPS 206.Requirements: fresh random salt per signature; constant-time Gaussian sampling; guard floating-point FFT against NaN, exceptional values and side channels across platforms; never reuse internal randomness across signatures.

statement.zh: Falcon 的安全性归约到 NTRU-SIS，但实现风险突出：签名端使用双精度浮点和离散高斯采样，缓存、时序和故障攻击可恢复私钥；随机数缺失会导致差分故障攻击。
statement.en: Falcon reduces to NTRU-SIS, but implementation risk dominates: signing uses double-precision floating point and discrete Gaussian sampling, so cache, timing and fault attacks can recover the private key; missing randomness enables differential fault attacks.Boundaries: signatures are variable-length, so protocols must budget the upper bound; Falcon is unsuitable when deterministic signatures are required; only 512/1024 parameter sets exist and cannot be rescaled; verification must check encoding length, ranges and subgroups.

statement.zh:
Falcon 由 Fouque、Hoffstein、Kirchner、Lyubashevsky、Pornin、Prest、Ricosset、Seiler、Whyte、Zhang 设计，2017-11-30 提交 NIST PQC；2022 年被 NIST 选为标准化签名之一，标准化名 FN-DSA，标准号为 FIPS 206（预计 2026 末到 2027 初发布）。它的前身是 NTRUSign，Fast Fourier sampling 来自 Ducas–Prest 2016 的陷门采样工作。**技术参数与复算边界**

本条的形式模型是 \((c,k)=\mathrm{Encaps}(pk);\qquad k'=\mathrm{Decaps}(sk,c)\)。输入：输入：Falcon 格签名的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：pk 公钥，sk 私钥，c 密文，k 会话密钥。
statement.en: Falcon was designed by Fouque, Hoffstein, Kirchner, Lyubashevsky, Pornin, Prest, Ricosset, Seiler, Whyte and Zhang and submitted to NIST PQC on 30 November 2017.NIST selected it in 2022; the standardized name is FN-DSA and the standard is FIPS 206, expected in late 2026 or early 2027.
